$:set -eu
root=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$root"' EXIT
while read -r repo run; do
  echo "DOWNLOAD $repo $run" >&2
  mkdir -p "$root/$repo"
  gh run download "$run" --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --name codespace-mcp-expression-inventory --dir "$root/$repo" >/dev/null
done <<'__REPOS__'

CommandLine 42573703776
Execution-Contract-Controller 42573862688
IssueScratch 42573864857
IssueStack- 42573867528
MCP-Collaborative 42573869494
StateMachines 42573871895
Surfaces 42573874240
Terminals 42573876389
__REPOS__
python3 - "$root" <<'PY'
import base64
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
from urllib.parse import quote

base=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
repos=[
  ('Canonical-Skills-Location',42573859935),
  ('CommandLine',42573703776),
  ('Execution-Contract-Controller',42573862688),
  ('IssueScratch',42573864857),
  ('IssueStack-',42573867528),
  ('MCP-Collaborative',42573869494),
  ('StateMachines',42573871895),
  ('Surfaces',42573874240),
  ('Terminals',42573876389)
]
pairs=collections.Counter()
pair_files=collections.defaultdict(set)
status=collections.Counter()
failed=[]
repo_rows=[]
total_expressions=0

for repo,run in repos:
    folder=base/repo
    manifests=list(folder.rglob('manifest.json'))
    assert len(manifests)==1, (repo,manifests)
    manifest=json.loads(manifests[0].read_text())
    contents={p.name:p for p in folder.rglob('*.json') if p.name!='manifest.json'}
    expected=[e for e in manifest['files'] if e['status']=='ok']
    count=0
    for entry in manifest['files']:
        status[entry['status']]+=1
        if entry['status']=='error':
            failed.append({'repository':'BestNameYet/'+repo,'file':entry.get('file'), 'error':entry.get('error')})
    for entry in expected:
        file=entry['file']
        filekey=pathlib.Path(entry['json']).name
        assert filekey in contents,(repo,filekey)
        data=json.loads(contents[filekey].read_text())
        arr=data['expressions']
        assert len(arr)==entry['expression_count'],(repo,file,len(arr),entry['expression_count'])
        for row in arr:
            name=row['enclosing_function_name']
            ftype=row['enclosing_function_type']
            assert name is None or isinstance(name,str),(repo,file,name)
            assert ftype is None or isinstance(ftype,str),(repo,file,ftype)
            key=(name,ftype)
            pairs[key]+=1
            pair_files[key].add((repo,file))
        count+=len(arr)
    repo_rows.append({'repository':'BestNameYet/'+repo,'run_id':run,
                      'parsed_files':len(expected),'expression_records':count,
                      'file_errors':sum(1 for e in manifest['files'] if e['status']=='error')})
    total_expressions+=count
    print('VERIFIED_SOURCE',repo,'parsed_files',len(expected),'expressions',count)

assert status['ok']==319,status
assert status['skipped_non_javascript']==453,status
assert status['error']==2,status
assert sum(status.values())==774,status
assert total_expressions==265283,(total_expressions,status)
assert sum(pairs.values())==total_expressions

def sort_key(pair):
    name,ftype=pair
    return (name is None, name or '', ftype is None, ftype or '')
unique=sorted(pairs, key=sort_key)
by_name=collections.defaultdict(list)
for name,ftype in unique:
    by_name[name].append(ftype)

file_contents={
    'schema':'enclosing-function-name-type-pairs/v1',
    'pairs':[{
        'enclosing_function_name':name,
        'enclosing_function_type':ftype,
        'expression_occurrences':pairs[(name,ftype)],
        'source_file_count':len(pair_files[(name,ftype)])
    } for name,ftype in unique],
    'by_name':[
        {'enclosing_function_name':name,
         'enclosing_function_types':sorted(by_name[name],key=lambda t:(t is None,t or ''))}
        for name in sorted(by_name, key=lambda n:(n is None,n or ''))
    ],
    'coverage':{
        'repositories':repo_rows,
        'source_expression_records':total_expressions,
        'source_files_parsed':status['ok'],
        'source_files_skipped_non_javascript':status['skipped_non_javascript'],
        'source_files_failed':status['error'],
        'unique_name_type_pairs':len(unique),
        'unique_names_including_null':len(by_name),
        'unique_nonnull_names':sum(name is not None for name in by_name),
        'unnamed_function_expression_occurrences':sum(v for (n,t),v in pairs.items() if n is None and t is not None),
        'outside_function_expression_occurrences':pairs[(None,None)],
        'parse_failures':failed
    }
}
dest='workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/enclosing-function-name-type-pairs.json'
encoded=(json.dumps(file_contents,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
repo='BestNameYet/Terminals'
def gh(method,uri,obj=None):
    args=['gh','api','--method',method,'repos/'+repo+'/'+uri]
    if obj is not None: args.extend(['--input','-'])
    proc=subprocess.run(args,input=json.dumps(obj) if obj is not None else None,
                        capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=100)
    if proc.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(method+' '+uri+' failed: '+proc.stderr[-1400:])
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)
try:
    gh('GET','contents/'+quote(dest,safe='/')+'?ref=main')
except RuntimeError as ex:
    if '404' not in str(ex):raise
else:
    raise RuntimeError('Refusing overwrite of existing result '+dest)
blob=gh('POST','git/blobs',{'content':base64.b64encode(encoded).decode(),'encoding':'base64'})
head=gh('GET','git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha']
tree=gh('GET','git/commits/'+head)['tree']['sha']
newtree=gh('POST','git/trees',{'base_tree':tree,'tree':[{
    'path':dest,'mode':'100644','type':'blob','sha':blob['sha']
}]})['sha']
commit=gh('POST','git/commits',{
    'message':'Aggregate all Babel enclosing function name/type pairs across nine scans',
    'tree':newtree,'parents':[head]})['sha']
gh('PATCH','git/refs/heads/main',{'sha':commit,'force':False})
read=gh('GET','git/blobs/'+blob['sha'])
assert base64.b64decode(read['content'])==encoded
assert json.loads(encoded)==file_contents
assert len(file_contents['pairs'])==len(set((x['enclosing_function_name'],x['enclosing_function_type']) for x in file_contents['pairs']))
print('COMMIT_RESULT',json.dumps({
    'verified':True,
    'commit':commit,'file':dest,
    'bytes':len(encoded),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),
    'pair_count':len(unique),
    'unique_nonnull_names':file_contents['coverage']['unique_nonnull_names'],
    'null_name_types':[(t,pairs[(None,t)]) for (n,t) in unique if n is None],
    'records':total_expressions,
    'failures':failed,
    'top_10':[
       {'name':n,'type':t,'count':count}
       for ((n,t),count) in pairs.most_common(10)]
},ensure_ascii=False))
